他先看见白阶两个字，再看见自己的名字，心里忽然一跳，竟以为是家里出了事。

pairs.english: There was indeed a drawing: not his original, but a wheel, pawl and bent strip on the back of printed paper.

若缺口旁有细裂，就不要再拿去承力。
他没有失望。

pairs.english: Instead of merely a workshop name, they had told him which pawl that tiny piece helped open and close.

把图转过来，弯片和爪子的位置便不一样了。

“不是不让你帮。”

剩下的话可以慢慢写。

pairs.english: The duty craftsman showed bolts behind the base: the lamp was fixed to its frame, not a portable lantern.

pairs.english: Tavi clarified and wrote the answer separately. His drawing for Ado had looked portable; he added the fixed mount.

pairs.english: In his evening home letter, he first asked about Sela's month-end budget review and included the lamp explanation for her to pass to Ado.

写到这里，他停住，把“山下”划掉，改成“鹿汊”。

“这就算？”
“这就算。”

pairs.english: Pavo nodded and cleared a clean corner of the table, then kept sewing the old ball. Thread lifted a little dust; he moved the ball away before Tavi asked.
